scope: Submitted compiled candidate and generated plain reference, source beats [0,12); no new capture/render or listening judgment.

method.frequencyFormula: Hz = observed complete SID frequency word * PAL clock / 2^24
method.pitchIdentity: Nearest equal-tempered MIDI with A4=440Hz; signed cents are retained separately.
method.timingFormula: Source absolute beat boundary * 60 / quarterBpm, quantized to nearest PAL call with exact rational arithmetic.
method.independence: Does not import the transfer preparer, MIDI-to-native-note mapping, player or frequency lookup; decodes complete ordered compiled SID writes directly.
method.stableBody: Every gated tonal end-of-call state from first tonal call to source note end has one frequency word; low/high intermediate bus words are not treated as notes.
method.timingLimit: Calls verify schedule. instructionStartCycle reports offsets within each call, not measured perceived acoustic onset.

interpretation.proven: All 53 stable tonal notes, source gate-on calls, gate-off calls and gaps match. Candidate and plain reference have identical body words and relative intervals. No compiled note mapping or timing defect was found.
interpretation.sharedTuning: Both versions retain the same native table, approximately 35 cents sharp of A440 equal temperament. This could differ from another remembered/reference rendition, but cannot by itself explain a candidate-versus-plain pitch difference.
interpretation.plausibleOnly: Candidate pulse timbre/PWM, six brief bass noise onsets and native release nibble 15 before earlier gaps can alter clarity or perceived pitch. A SID voice retains the current oscillator word after gate-off; its release carries through the gap until retrigger, rather than mixing independent old and new pitches on that voice. These are possible perceptual influences, not an established cause of the user's uncertainty.
interpretation.finalRelease: The submitted final release is shortened from nibble 15 to 9 at each voice's final note end; the retained audio check reports zero final-window AC RMS.
interpretation.notEstablished: This check does not judge transcription fidelity to an external score/performance or determine why the listener perceived a slightly wrong tune. It compares the submitted files with the existing songs/fuer-elise.json source only.
